name: hooklane
description: Production-oriented webhook and workflow automation platform.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w worker
scripts.check:redis: docker compose exec redis redis-cli ping
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @hooklane/contracts && npm run build -w @hooklane/queue && npm run build -w @hooklane/db
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w api
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w worker
scripts.lint:api: npm run build:packages && npm run lint -w api
scripts.lint:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run lint -w worker
